data.title: War Robots: Frontiers — Play Now For Free On PlayStation, Xbox & PC!
data.summary: A new free-to-play mech shooter experience has landed!
data.meta_title: War Robots: Frontiers — Play Now For Free On PlayStation, Xbox & PC!
data.content:
Suit up, Pilots. War Robots: Frontiers is now available to play for free! Squad up with full crossplay on PlayStation®5, PlayStation®4, Xbox Series X|S™, Xbox One™, and Windows PC via Steam and MY.GAMES Launcher!

Construct, customize, and battle online with 18 War Robots, fight across four maps and three explosive game modes, and discover new worlds in Season 1: Blockade. 

Wanna see what’s new and improved since Early Access? Read the Update 1.0 patch notes at the end of this article.

Season 1: Blockade

Terminus, the gateway to the Wild Ten system, erupts in chaos. With supplies cut off, clever mechanics on Tortuga scramble to rebuild broken War Robots as Pilots ready themselves for a new fight. Prove your mettle to break the blockade in Season 1:Blockade, and take your place among the elite Pilots of the Wild Ten.

Jump into the cockpit today and experience:

  • 4 Interstellar Maps
    • Terminus: Fight for control of this spaceport, cargo-handling facility, and gateway to the Wild Ten system.
    • Spectrum: Battle around a colossal Warp needle on this research site that erupts in constant chaotic combat.
    • Catalyst: This geothermal power generation plant features dangerous lava pools and plenty of opportunities for sniping.
    • Fissure: A Noachium mining complex with a secret weapon that can turn the tide of battle in an instant—the Crusher!
  • 3 Thrilling Game Modes
    • Team Deathmatch (TDM): The first team to 30 eliminations wins!
    • Last Robot Standing (LRS): Destroy all enemy War Robots before they destroy yours.
    • Warp Rush: Hold Warp Gates with your team to accumulate Control Points. Reach the Control Point target to win, or defeat all enemy Robots.
  • 18 Battle-Primed War Robots: Ares, Bulgasari, Bulwark, Fenrir, Fury, Griffin, Harpy, Lancelot, Orochi, Phantom, Purifier, Pursuer, Ravana, Raven, Siren, Typhon, Tyr, and Varangian
  • 3 Colossal Titans: Alpha, Grim, and Matriarch

Level up your Under The Wire Battle Pass (coming March 11) to unlock over 35 galactic rewards, including exclusive cosmetics, battle gear, and the brand-new War Robot: Cyclops!

Celestial Celebrations

Celebrate the launch of War Robots: Frontiers with interstellar activities! 

  • Daily Login Rewards (March 4–April 4): Play 1 Battle daily to receive Stickers, Premium Account Time, Salvage, Credits, and Intel!
  • Sign Up Rewards (March 4-April 22): Play today and receive special gifts, including a Nebula Wrap, 1,500 Credits, and 7,500 Salvage.
  • Subscribe to the Newsletter: Get all the latest news from the frontier straight to your inbox. Sign up today to claim rewards like Joshua Smith (Common Pilot), Vortex (Weapon), and 10,000 Credits.
  • Twitch Drops (March 4–24): Watch your favorite streams to earn Credits, Salvage, and Premium Time. You can also gift two subscriptions to claim the Oni Renegade Wrap!
  • Sign Up For Messenger: Enlist for War Robots: Frontiers transmissions via Messenger and add a free Vortex Weapon and 20,000 Salvage to your Hangar by confirming your subscription.

Welcome to the Wild Ten, Pilot!

You’ve just arrived in a newly discovered planetary system, lightyears from Earth. Prepare to unleash the power of War Robots in intense online PvP battles across the Wild Ten.

  • TACTICAL MECH ACTION: Pilot colossal war machines with your team, executing tactical gambits to outsmart rivals and seize victory. Fight for survival in Last Robot Standing, control key points in Warp Rush, and go all-out for eliminations in Team Deathmatch. Prove yourself and rise through the ranks in Leagues.
  • ENGINEER YOUR VICTORY: Build the ultimate War Robot by customizing it with skilled Pilots, a devastating arsenal of weapons, and special abilities from Gear. Unlock exclusive cosmetics to make your build stand out in battle!
  • UNLEASH TITANIC DESTRUCTION: Once you’ve built enough power, unleash your ultimate weapon—a Titan. These colossal machines bring unique abilities to the fight. Choose the perfect moment to turn the tide of battle with destructive force.
  • EXPAND YOUR UNIVERSE: Seasons, events, and Battle Passes bring fresh content, including new modes, maps, weapons, and more. Every battle is a new opportunity for glory.

Immerse yourself in the War Robots Universe, rise through the ranks, and make a name for yourself on the Wild Ten!

Test Your Metal In Leagues 

Move up the Ranks in Leagues—War Robots: Frontiers for Pilots with a more competitive streak. Battle against other Pilots in your skill bracket, progress through Ranks, and claim rewards. 

Download War Robots: Frontiers for free today:

PlayStation®5│PlayStation®4│ Xbox Series X|S™ │Xbox One™

Steam │ MY.GAMES Launcher

Stay tuned to our official X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok channels and join the War Robots: Frontiers subreddit, for all the latest news and updates.

1.0 Patch Notes 

New Features & Content

  • New Map: Terminus
  • New War Robot: Cyclops (Assault Class)
    • Available in the Under the Wire Battle Pass starting March 11.
  • New Weapon: Gemini (Heavy Rocket Launcher)
    • Available in the Under the Wire Battle Pass starting March 11.
  • New Legendary Pilot: Idy “King” Demerost
  • New Customization Options: Paints, Wear & Tear, Stickers, Decals, and Wraps

Game System Changes

  • During War Robot customization, Wraps can now be applied by pressing Spacebar.
  • The talents menu for Pilots has been renamed from “Rank Up” to “Talents”.
    • The “Rank up” button has been removed.
  • Updated sound effects in the Workshop UI.
  • Improved VFX for Module preview in the Warehouse and Shop.
  • Improved lighting in the Hangar.
  • Changed AI-opponent names.
  • Improved VFX when War Robots are interacting with water surfaces.
  • Changed the Reward screen visuals:
    • Rewards are now separated by their sources.
  • Improved Crew invite notifications and interaction:
    • Players will now see an “Accept” button that automatically adds them to the Crew.
  • Changed the sequence of the post-battle screens:
    • The sequence begins with “Details”. The “Drop Team” statistics will now only open when the button is clicked.
  • Changed the behavior of the Module Details window:
    • When opening and closing the details of the selected Module, the player will now return to the Workshop/Warehouse with the Module highlighted that was previously selected.
  • Changed visuals for Common Pilots.

Balancing Changes (War Robots & Titans)

Fenrir (War Robot)

  • Unchained (Core Gear)
    • Increased the cooldown of Unchained. At the highest level the cooldown has been increased from 30s to 40s.
    • Reduced the HP recovery rate for damage. At the highest level the HP recovery rate has been reduced from 100% to 85%.

Matriarch (Titan)

  • Scrubber (Weapon)
    • Increased the bullet spread from 0.6 to 1.
  • Singulators (Weapon)
    • Removed the delay before the first drone starts shooting down enemy projectiles.

Raven (War Robot)

  • Steel Feathers (Core Gear)
    • Decreased the projectile spread to 0.

Balancing Changes (Weapons)

Ghost Turret

  • Decreased the attack range to 110m.

Incinerator

  • Decreased damage to armor from 666 to 350.
  • Decreased damage to shields from 368 to 200.
  • Increased Armor-DoT (per second) from 1,000 to 18,000.
  • Increased Shield-DoT (per second) from 1,000 to 3,000.

Railgun

  • Increased damage to armor from 4,614 to 4,900.
  • Increased damage to shields from 5,609 to 5,750.

Scourge

  • Reduced clip size from 100 to 90.

Shocktrain

  • Increased the max. Charge time from 1s to 1.4s.
  • Increased the time to reload from 2.4s to 3.6s.

Trebuchet

  • Decreased damage to armor from 10,363 to 9,950.
  • Decreased damage to shields from 9,380 to 9,000.

Trident

  • The behavior of the AoE damage of Trident has been adjusted:
    • AoE damage has been redistributed. Some of the AoE damage is now applied to shields.
    • The ratio between direct armor damage and AoE damage has been adjusted. Direct damage is higher, AoE damage is lower.
  • Increased the projectile velocity by 23%.
  • Increased damage to armor from 6,590 to 6,890.
  • Decreased damage to shields from 4,810 to 4,510.
  • Increased the rate of fire from 0.556 to 0.625.
  • Increased the time to reload from 2.3s to 2.5s.

Bug Fixes

Audio

  • Fixed a bug where the battle music may play twice after reconnecting to a match.

Maps

  • Catalyst: Fixed a bug where players could collide with invisible walls.

Pilot Talents

  • Fire Support (Talent): This Talent now only activates when there are at least 2 allies within 100 meters of the player.
  • Offensive Tactics (Talent): Fixed a bug where the Pilot talent “Offensive Tactics” did not increase Gear damage.
  • Gearhead (Talent): Fixed a bug where two cooldown periods are displayed after using an ability and the Talent “Gearhead” is active.

Titans

  • Alpha: Fixed a bug where the VFX for Firestorm (Titan Gear) was not visible in certain cases.
  • Grim: Fixed a bug where the damage dealt by Ripper (Titan Gear) was not counted to the post battle statistics.
  • Grim: Fixed a bug where Snare (Titan Gear) could attach to the War Robots Griffin and Purifier if Scrambler or Zealot (Core Gears) were active, allowing the Snare to move.
  • Grim: Fixed a bug where the VFX for Katzbalger (Titan Weapon) would briefly disappear when ammo is consumed.

Tutorial & Firing Range

  • Fixed a bug where the tutorial music was played after closing the tutorial.
  • Fixed a bug where players were not able to enter the Firing Range after customizing a Titan.

War Robots & Gear

  • Fixed a bug where the War Robot that was just created was not selected after exiting the “Create War Robot” screen.
  • Fixed a bug where the name randomizer button for War Robots would clear the field instead of generating a name.
  • Fixed a bug where Gear icons could clip into the War Robot in the Workshop.
  • Fixed a bug where War Robot icons in the progression screen displayed a white box instead of the War Robot part.
  • Ares: Fixed a bug where Wrath (Core Gear) did not visually match the shield that was deployed.
  • Purifier: Fixed a bug where the damage bonus of the Core Gear Zealot did not always apply to the weapons Trebuchet, Shredder, and Scourge.
  • Varangian: Fixed a bug where Energy Dome (Core Gear) could restrict enemy movement.
  • Varangian: Fixed a bug where Energy Dome (Core Gear) was not visible to the player who deployed it.

Weapons

  • Fixed a bug where weapon slots were named Heavy Weapon if they could fit both Light or Heavy weapons. The slots are now correctly named “Any Weapon”.
